cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take half Mum's care-home forms. We are both her children; I can't also be the entire admissions department.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll put you as main contact. You understand these.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Main contact takes the calls; it doesn't mean 'knows everything.' Put your number down. I'll help with anything you can't answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll be ringing you every time they ask something.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while they're still talking. Write the question down, finish the call, then ring me. We'll work it out together.

reason: Owner finding: B offers a plausible contact allocation rather than making an invented address mistake. A corrects that interpretation, then supervises B's proposed calls while maintaining shared family responsibility.
